name: Insurance claims triage

intake.description: Automated triage of insurance claims, scoring claims for eligibility and fraud risk assessment

source_note: Classifier: Annex III(5)(b) per S1 (suite-verified). Derivation: Art. 6 is the high-risk classification rule; the high-risk regime is Ch. III Sec. 2, of which risk management (9) and human oversight (14) are the core obligations for a fully-automated decision system.

name: HR resume screening

intake.description: Screening of job candidate resumes to rank applicants for recruitment shortlisting
intake.intended_purpose: Speed up hiring by ranking candidates

source_note: Classifier: Annex III(4)(a) per S2 (suite-verified). Derivation: recruitment is the canonical bias-sensitive use case, so data & data governance (10) joins the classification rule (6) and risk management (9); NIST MEASURE 2.11 covers fairness evaluation.

name: Real-time biometric ID for law enforcement

intake.description: Real-time facial recognition for biometric identification of individuals in public spaces by police
intake.intended_purpose: Identify suspects in real-time surveillance feeds

source_note: Classifier: Art. 5(1)(h) per S4 post-1.0.1 (suite-verified; Finding 1). Derivation: for a prohibited system, Article 5 sections (prohibition, exceptions, conditions) are the only must-retrieve; demanding Art. 6 would punish retrieval for being correct about a banned system.

name: Internal spam filter (G-min-01)

intake.description: Classifies internal emails as spam or not spam for inbox filtering

source_note: Classifier: minimal per S8 (suite-verified). THE G-min-01 case (Phase 2 Finding 2): a minimal-risk report must not surface high-risk regime obligations; Art. 80 (procedure for non-high-risk under Annex III) is the structurally on-point provision.

name: Customer-service chatbot

intake.description: Customer service chatbot answering product questions in natural conversation

source_note: Classifier: Art. 50(1) per S6 (suite-verified). Derivation: limited-risk = the Art. 50 transparency regime only; the high-risk regime is inapplicable, so Art. 9 must not appear in the report.

name: Insurance risk + biometric categorization (multi-match)

intake.description: Insurance risk assessment that also performs biometric categorization of applicants for premium pricing and underwriting
intake.intended_purpose: Personalize insurance premiums using multiple data signals

source_note: Classifier: Annex III(1)(b) first-match per S9 (suite-verified). Derivation: the multi-category case is exactly where the Annex III text itself must be retrievable (annex_iii chunks), alongside the classification rule (6) and risk management (9).

name: Bank credit scoring

intake.description: Credit scoring model assessing creditworthiness for loan approval decisions

source_note: Classifier: Annex III(5)(b) creditworthiness per S3 (suite-verified). Derivation: same bias-sensitive shape as hiring — data governance (10) is central; 6 and 9 as for all high-risk.

name: Marketing image generator

intake.description: Generates synthetic marketing images and produces text content for advertising campaigns

source_note: Classifier: Art. 50(2) synthetic-content marking per S7 (suite-verified). Same limited-risk derivation as G-05: Art. 50 regime only.

name: Workplace emotion recognition

intake.description: Emotion recognition system monitoring employee emotional state during work hours

source_note: Classifier: Art. 5(1)(f) per S5, the ordering case (suite-verified — prohibited evaluated before Annex III(4)). Prohibited derivation as G-03: Article 5 sections only.

name: Inventory demand forecasting

intake.description: Forecasts warehouse inventory demand from historical sales data

source_note: Classifier: minimal per v1 unit test test_minimal_risk_inventory_forecast (verified). Second minimal-risk case so G-04 isn't alone; same Art. 80 derivation and high-risk-exclusion rule.

name: GPAI foundation-model service (documented edge)

intake.description: A general-purpose foundation model API offering text generation to downstream developers
intake.intended_purpose: Provide a general-purpose language model as a service

source_note: Classifier: limited/Art. 50(2) per S10 — DOCUMENTED edge behavior, not full GPAI handling (Art. 51-56 overlay is Phase 5). Expectations deliberately reflect current behavior; when the overlay ships, this entry gains Art. 51-56 expectations and the change is itself evidence.

name: Online exam proctoring

intake.description: Monitors students via webcam during online exams to flag suspected cheating behaviors for instructor review
intake.intended_purpose: Maintain exam integrity in remote education

source_note: NEW entry (no suite precedent — verify tier pre-freeze). Derivation: monitoring students during tests is Annex III(3) education territory; description deliberately behavior-focused (not emotion) to avoid the 5(1)(f) prohibition. Human oversight (14) central given instructor-review design.

name: Public benefits eligibility scoring

intake.description: Evaluates eligibility of citizens for public assistance benefits and social services

source_note: Tier verified pre-freeze — verification CAUGHT a classifier coverage gap: no Annex III(5)(a) rule existed; added under CLASSIFIER_VERSION 1.1.0 with scenario S11. Derivation: essential public services eligibility is Annex III(5)(a); fully-automated determinations over vulnerable populations make data governance (10) and risk management (9) core alongside the classification rule (6).
